name: list_shaders
description: Lists the shader effects and shader fills in the authenticated user's account library. Returns each shader's id, name, description, owner, and type (effect or fill), plus a nextCursor when more pages exist. Owner is the authenticated user's email for their shaders, or figma for first-party shaders. Use the id with get_shader to read either shader type's source.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned as nextCursor by a previous call. Omit to fetch the first page.
